name: Brine Road West & Scuba Gear
summary: Surf west from Kindle Road across the rolling ocean waters of Brine Road West towards Boon Island. Meet the deep-sea researcher near the trench who gives you the Scuba Gear, the essential HM replacement tool for Dive that lets you submerge into underwater chasms without teaching Dive to any party member. Gather valuable coastal treasures including a Sun Stone, a Nugget, and hidden Heart Scales nestled in the coral shallows.
